profile.name: Pranjal Jaiswal
profile.title: MIS Executive & Data Analyst
profile.tagline: Turning Raw Data into Actionable Strategy.

paragraphs: I am an MIS Executive & Data Analyst with 2+ years of experience transforming complex, multi-source datasets into high-impact operational insights. My expertise spans SQL, Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Python (Pandas/NumPy), and Advanced Excel with VBA.

Whether automating repetitive ETL workflows to save hundreds of manual hours, building real-time SLA monitoring dashboards for C-level leadership, or performing predictive cohort analysis to boost conversion rates, I focus on driving tangible business metrics.
